failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds the mean of the last 28 days by more than 5 percentage points despite WORKPLACES remaining below -30%.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days while PARKS remains above 15% in more than 40% of daily observations.
